owner_names: Origin Group DN, Inc.; Origin Group AZ, Inc.
footnote_text: Each Class B Unit of XTI Drones Holdings, LLC, a subsidiary of the Issuer, was exchangeable for one share of common stock of the Issuer for no additional consideration (subject to adjustment) under Section 8.8 of the XTI Drones Holdings, LLC Amended and Restated Company Agreement, dated as of November 10, 2025, subject to the conditions set forth therein, which were satisfied as of the exchange on November 18, 2026. The Class B Units have no expiration date. On November 18, 2026, each Reporting Person exchanged all of its Class B Units for an equal number of shares of Common Stock on a one-for-one basis. Following the exchange, no Class B Units are held by either Reporting Person. || These securities are held directly by The Origin Group DN, Inc., which is a member of a "group" with The Origin Group AZ, Inc. for purposes of Section 13(d) of the Exchange Act.
